description:

## Why this exists
At 13:20:33Z/13:20:36Z I set `0dd3f3d4` and `f4e116f1` to `Doing`/`doing`/`high` with `wake_at=+4h`. Both returned `success` and both had been reverted by 13:21:20Z/13:21:26Z (see `.codx/tasks/IT team/Backlog/`). The engine had a turn running on each card at the time. Re-applying the write now would just be reverted again, so it is scheduled instead.

## Do this when woken
1. `get_task` both cards. If a turn is no longer running, re-apply the intended state with **one full payload** each:
   - `0dd3f3d4-5deb-4a8c-b36a-6f381f1cc91b` → `board="IT team"`, `column="Doing"`, `status="doing"`, `priority="high"`, `wake_at="+1d"`
   - `f4e116f1-1792-4191-b75a-d3a7f21b84a6` → same payload
   - `0159931a-831c-46fe-b519-b35919d957ec` → `status="todo"`, `priority="high"`, stays in `Backlog`, `wake_at="+1d"`
2. Read back **≥ 5 s later** and paste both reads into this card. If they reverted again, do **not** keep retrying: add that fact to `0159931a` and leave it for `software_developer`.
3. Verify the actual outcomes, not the columns:
   - `0dd3f3d4`: does a comment exist with `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest:api")` showing `errors: 0` and `passed > 0`?
   - `f4e116f1`: is there a pasted `get_task` read-back proving (a) one call with `column` **and** `wake_at` yields both, (b) a `progress`-only call leaves `column`/`status`/`wake_at` byte-identical?
4. Check `c6c33374-631b-44de-87d8-a7351acde8be` (board `codx-junior maintenance`, column `Blocked`, security P1: JWT/HMAC key 17 bytes, due 2026-11-18) for assistant output since 2026-11-17 12:00Z. The closed escalation `65f32bce` named this card as its close condition and I closed it on other evidence; if this card still shows no assistant reply, re-open `65f32bce` or escalate again. It is outside the IT team board, so it is tracked here deliberately.
